changes: A primary Streamable HTTP SSE response and one SDK control POST coexist inside one registered worker; no detached task is spawned.
Only SDK protocol replies/notifications can be sent while the primary call waits. Responses/notifications require202; a rejected or stalled control exchange preserves the original tool as unknown.
Direction matters: a same-id server request is not a response to the client call. Different-id and same-id ping cases each run two actual MCP calls with one grant per call.
Only the response bound to the real initialize id sets negotiated protocol version. The same-named Tool Result field remains in raw factual output and cannot alter later headers.
HTTP redirect and protocol-NACK retry are explicitly disabled. No request replay is introduced.
A cancelled bootstrap emits cancelled + not_dispatched, retains actual known billing and proves the owned stdio child was reaped. Sent cancellations remain unknown.

Model fixture listener lifetime follows its explicit owner; socket read/write waits remain3seconds and a deliberately stalled response remains bounded15seconds. Drop requests stop and joins the worker.

PTY tests separately require a persisted approved/denied/cancelled fact within5seconds, then bound the actual remaining model/tool/stop/billing episode within15seconds. Child ownership now guarantees cleanup on failed assertions. Existing effect/exit/status/unknown assertions remain.
A16-second approval wait verifies ongoing lease renewal, no pre-approval effect, actual granted write, subsequent model response and managed pause.
remaining: MCP credentialRef/Vault/legacy migration and OAuth/network/session parity; remaining auth/private wires, Context/compaction strategy/capabilities, Skill/Plugin/Hook, headless/ACP/commands and full P4 real-model/platform acceptance. P5 has not started.
limits: Deterministic native fixture servers and actual public CLI, not live provider/MCP credentials or installed-build acceptance.
No P6 1GiB/four-hour soak or release/product regression performed.
No personal data touched, no app restart/install/tag/release/default-entry switch.
Native non-none MCP auth still blocks before cognition. Native engine has no Bun/Node sidecar.
